Leonardo Bryton McGennis

McGennis Family - Eldest Son

Future Leader

About Leonardo

Leonardo Bryton McGennis is the eldest son of Caleb Michael McGennis and Stephanie Kay McGennis, growing up in Jefferson City, Missouri with a family building businesses and serving the community.

Leonardo is being raised with strong family values, entrepreneurial spirit, and community engagement that defines the McGennis family legacy in Central Missouri.

Interests & Fun Facts

Gymnastics Champion

Leonardo has been doing gymnastics since he was 3 years old, developing strength, discipline, and determination from an early age.

Favorite Color

Leonardo's favorite color is red - bold, energetic, and full of life, just like him!

Lightning McQueen Superfan

Leonardo absolutely loves Lightning McQueen from Disney's Cars. His passion for the speedy race car runs so deep that when his family asked what he wanted to name his baby brother before Raphael was born, he would always say with excitement: "Lightning McQueen!"

While his brother ended up with the name Raphael Corwyn, Leonardo's enthusiasm for Lightning McQueen remains as strong as ever.
